notes:
CRM notes: mid-market PLG SaaS (product analytics). Evaluating Redwood hosted -> Dedicated. Strong product and infra team involvement. Short bullets and meeting recaps below.

Recent timeline:
- 2026-02-18: Intro call (Maya) w/ VP Product (Ethan Park) + Eng Lead (Sara Molina). Quick demo of hosted API. Interest: low-friction onboarding, predictable P50/P95 latencies.
- 2026-02-25: Deep-dive (Liam SE) — architecture review + security questionnaire intake. Fireflies ff-2026-02-25-AB123.
- 2026-03-05: Pricing + POC scoping (Maya, Liam, Ethan). Shared pricing deck (drive). Follow-up: POC plan and test dataset. Fireflies ff-2026-03-05-AB456.
- 2026-03-11: Internal legal/cyber review requested Redwood security FAQ and SOC2 evidence.

POC scope (agreed):
- Phase 1 (hosted): 2-week trial using Redwood hosted API for chat-based product assistant and embedding store for search. Measure latency (p95 goal < 250ms) and cost at current traffic.
- Phase 2 (Dedicated eval): If hosted meets latency and infra/security gating, run 2-week dedicated run on a small reserved pool for throughput characterization.

Tech & requirements (notes):
- Primary workloads: chat assistant (context windows ~2-6k tokens), semantic search via embeddings (batch embedding jobs overnight), reranking for top-K results.
- Latency targets: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 250ms for chat in normal traffic. Throughput target: 200 concurrent sessions with ~10 req/min per session at peak.
- Cost sensitivity: high—VP Product expects clear unit economics (cost per DAU, cost per 1k tokens). Target ARR threshold to justify Dedicated: > $120k.
- Data residency: customer data must remain in us-east and be auditable. Legal asked for retention controls and KMS integration.

Model preferences & routing: 
- Prefer open LLaMA- derivative and Florence-style models for embeddings; want Redwood to recommend quantized variants for Dedicated.
- Need routing/fallback: primary hosted model -> cheaper distilled variant on Dedicated during peak -> degrade to cached responses if cold start.

Cost-optimization workshop (requested):
- Workshop agenda: profiling current prompt/token mix, batching strategies for embeddings and chat, KV/prefix caching, quantization profiles (q4_0, int8) tradeoffs, sample unit-economics.
- Saved notes from 2026-03-05 pricing call: team asked for a worked example showing savings switching to Dedicated with aggressive batching + q4_0 quantization — request: "show us token-level math with 6 common flows".

Preliminary POC numbers (assumptions from call):
- Baseline hosted run (estimate): 12M tokens/mo -> ~$7k/mo @ hosted price (example numbers we used in deck).
- With Dedicated + batching + KV caching -> expected 35-55% token cost reduction (batching embeddings, prefix caching for chat), further 20-35% savings with int8/q4 quantization on certain model families while maintaining evaluation-quality thresholds.
- Team wants Redwood to produce an "apples-to-apples" comparison with token counts from their sample week (shared in Drive).

Quotes & tone:
- Ethan (VP Product): "We need really concrete numbers — I don't buy blanket statements. Show me the math with our traffic."
- Sara (Eng Lead): "Latency is non-negotiable; we can trade some quality for cost but not at the expense of UX."
